name: techdella/faq
title: FAQ
description: Questions and answers as <details> (no FAQPage schema, §8.2).

items.question: How long does SEO take to work?
items.answer: Technical fixes can show impact within weeks; content usually takes a few months to compound. Paycape saw its first results in 50 days.

items.question: Do you guarantee first-page rankings?
items.answer: No. Nobody controls Google’s rankings. We commit to a clear roadmap, quality work and transparent reporting.

items.question: What’s the difference between SEO and AI search optimization?
items.answer: SEO gets your pages ranked on Google. AI search optimization gets your brand mentioned in AI answers. They share foundations, and we usually run them together.

items.question: Can you work with our existing website?
items.answer: Yes. We work in WordPress, Webflow and most modern CMSs. If you need a rebuild, TechDella Studios can help.

techdella.help: Items: {question, answer}. Answer the question in the first sentence. Blank lines in an answer start a new paragraph. This block never outputs FAQPage schema (Google limits it to government/health sites).
